decisions.reason: As a still-relevant sensing module for the firm's modular platform, it likely remains worth carrying, though after several years sensor-specific demand and component risk make withdrawal materially possible if sales are modest.

Because this voltage measurement module is a core platform function and already serves as the successor generation to an established product, management would usually retain it unless a newer replacement is imminent.
The MQTT proxy is a low-cost software complement that broadens integration options for hardware customers, so its option value remains high relative to its carrying cost.
A CAN bus interface fits German industrial and embedded use cases well and strengthens the ecosystem, making continued availability more attractive than exit unless demand has clearly disappointed.

The CO2 sensor module still matches educational, building-monitoring, and automation applications, so management would likely keep it while accepting some risk from specialized demand and sensor sourcing.

As a more peripheral accessory with lower strategic importance than core modules and several years for demand to reveal itself, its remaining option value is likely too limited to justify continued support.
